title: MUVO: A Multimodal Generative World Model for Autonomous Driving with Geometric Representations

output_modality.value: camera images, lidar point clouds (range view) and optional 3D occupancy grids, predicted for future frames

control_signal.value: actions fed to the transition model; their form (e.g. steering, trajectory) is not detailed in packet.

control_mechanism.value: Transition model on fused latent states conditioned on actions; transformer-style attention uses hidden states as queries and concatenated hidden state, action and observation as key-value pairs.

base_model.value: Simple MILE-style architecture with pretrained ResNet18 encoders, transformer sensor fusion, transition model and multimodal decoders (2D convolution for camera and lidar, 3D convolution for voxels).

metrics.value: PSNR for images, Chamfer Distance for point clouds, IoU, Precision and Recall for 3D occupancy.

closed_loop.value: No; open-loop prediction on sequences, 6 or 4 frames given as observations and 6 or 2 as ground truth.

stated_limitations.value: not stated in packet; notes occupancy prediction is computationally intensive and benefits for sensor prediction are only slight.

notes: Paper is mainly a sensor-fusion ablation study; the action control is part of the architecture but is not evaluated in the packet. Datasets named only by abbreviations. [datasets: validation sets referred to only as DRL_val and DDS_val] [controllability_evidence: experiments compare sensor fusion strategies and occupancy prediction, not action-following.]
